subject: Cyber Monday
title: When is cyber monday: Nov. 30, 2026, the Monday after Thanksgiving
answer: Cyber Monday 2026 falls on Monday, November 30. It is the Monday after Thanksgiving (Nov. 26), three days after Black Friday (Nov. 27), and is the biggest online shopping day of the year in the U.S.
body:
The name was coined in 2005 by Shop.org, part of the National Retail Federation, after retailers noticed a jump in online orders on the Monday after Thanksgiving. Because it follows Thanksgiving, the date moves each year and always falls between Nov. 26 and Dec. 2. In 2027 it will be Nov. 29.

Cyber Monday 2025 (Dec. 1, 2025) set a record of $14.25 billion in U.S. online spending, according to Adobe Analytics, making it the biggest online shopping day ever. For the 2026 season, Adobe forecast $275.1 billion in U.S. online sales from Nov. 1 to Dec. 31.

Many deals now start well before the day itself. Walmart announced three holiday sales events running from Nov. 12 through Dec. 2, 2026, and Target ran an early Black Friday sale on Nov. 5–7. Many stores keep Cyber Monday prices going for the rest of that week, often called Cyber Week.
in_the_news: With Black Friday on Nov. 27, 2026, retailers have already started early holiday sales, and shoppers are checking the Cyber Monday date.

faq.q: How much do people spend on Cyber Monday?
faq.a: In 2025, U.S. shoppers spent a record $14.25 billion online on Cyber Monday, according to Adobe Analytics.
